title: Massive Russian attack kills at least 20
summary: Russia launched a 'massive' missile and drone attack across Ukraine, including Kyiv.

title: Houthi attack on Riyadh's King Khalid airport
summary: A Houthi strike on King Khalid International Airport killed 12–13 people and wounded about 300, per Saudi officials and CNN — the deadliest attack on Saudi soil in more than a decade.

title: US disables blockade runner in Gulf of Oman
summary: CENTCOM said it disabled a commercial vessel whose crew ignored repeated warnings and tried to bypass the US blockade of Iranian ports.

title: Two killed near Israeli-occupied zone in Bint Jbeil district
summary: Lebanon's NNA said one man was killed by Israeli shelling and another by a leftover munition in Bint Jbeil district.

title: Coalition strikes Houthi oil sites in Sanaa
summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it struck oil sites across western Yemen, including Sanaa and Hodeidah province, in response to the Riyadh airport attack.

title: Houthis claim strike on Aramco headquarters
summary: The Houthis claimed a strike on Saudi Aramco's headquarters in Dhahran hours after coalition strikes on Sanaa.

title: Houthi missile toward Riyadh intercepted
summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi missile launched toward Riyadh.

title: Ukraine resumes refinery strikes on Ryazan after brief truce
summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region hours after Zelenskyy said a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

title: Houthi missile attack on Aden presidential palace kills five
summary: Yemen's health minister said five people were killed and 16 injured when Houthi missiles targeted the al-Maashiq palace.

title: Mass Ukrainian drone raid hits St. Petersburg oil terminal
summary: Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia overnight, striking an oil terminal in St. Petersburg.

title: Drone attack on Moscow
summary: Hundreds of Ukrainian drones targeted Moscow and St. Petersburg despite pressure from President Trump.

title: Army intercepts RSF suicide drones in the east
summary: Sudan's army said it intercepted RSF suicide drones aimed at positions and infrastructure in Gedaref and Kassala. No casualties reported.

title: RSF drone kills three children near Khartoum airport
summary: Sudan Tribune reported army air defenses downed RSF drones over Khartoum; one crashed into a house, killing three children.

title: RSF drones knock out power stations in the east
summary: Coordinated RSF drone strikes hit five power stations in eastern Sudan, causing widespread outages. Point shows eastern Sudan generally.

title: Drone strike on Nyala market kills 21
summary: A drone strike on a market in Nyala, South Darfur, reportedly killed 21 people; attribution was not established.

title: Israeli shelling of al-Mansouri and Majdal Zoun
summary: Lebanese state media reported Israeli shelling of the southern towns of al-Mansouri and Majdal Zoun; no casualties reported.

title: Coalition says Houthi missiles and drones downed
summary: The coalition said it intercepted three ballistic missiles fired toward the Eastern Region and four drones toward the south.

title: Israeli strikes kill 10 across Gaza
summary: PCHR reported 10 Palestinians killed by Israeli strikes and gunfire across Gaza between 26 and 28 October.

title: IDF says four Hamas operatives killed in southern Gaza
summary: The IDF said four Hamas operatives, including a Nukhba Force member in Khan Younis, were killed in strikes in southern Gaza; two people were reportedly killed in a vehicle strike in Maghazi camp.

title: Tanker hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz
summary: UKMTO reported a tanker struck by a projectile while exiting the strait along the US-promoted southern route.

title: Limpet mines set tanker Louise 1 on fire
summary: A small boat attached two limpet mines to the Panama-flagged tanker Louise 1, which caught fire. No injuries reported.

title: Iran says vessels disabled by sea mines
summary: Iran's navy and the IRGC claimed several vessels struck mines on the southern route; UKMTO confirmed one ship seen on fire. CENTCOM insists the southern lanes are safe and open.

title: Strikes on Dnipropetrovsk power grid
summary: Power outages followed Russian attacks on the regional grid, part of a day of daytime drone strikes that reportedly killed at least 19 across Ukraine.

title: Ukraine hits drone depot near Navlya
summary: Ukraine's General Staff reported hitting a drone storage depot, a launch point and a fuel warehouse in Bryansk Oblast.

title: Ukraine strikes radars near Starodub
summary: Two Russian radar stations reported hit in Bryansk Oblast.

title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon
summary: Shelling and drone strikes reported around Mayfadoun and Zawtar al-Sharqiyah.

title: Missile strike in central Chernihiv kills two teenagers
summary: Ukrainian officials said a Russian missile strike in central Chernihiv killed two 15-year-old girls and wounded more than 20.

title: Drones hit apartment block in Kremenchuk
summary: A daytime drone attack on a residential building killed at least three people; reported injuries range from 15 to 32.

title: Neptune strike destroys two Su-34s at Marinovka
summary: Ukraine's Navy and General Staff said Neptune missiles destroyed two Su-34 bombers at Marinovka airfield, Volgograd Oblast. Not independently verified.

title: 613 drones target Moscow; airports restricted
summary: Mayor Sobyanin said 613 drones flew toward the Moscow region overnight; Vnukovo, Domodedovo and Zhukovsky airports imposed restrictions.

title: Ballistic missiles and drones hit Kyiv
summary: Overnight Russian ballistic missile and drone attack on Kyiv; one killed and one injured in the Dniprovskyi district. Nationwide Russia launched missiles and 113 drones.

title: Strikes on Odesa port and energy facility
summary: Russia's defence ministry said its overnight strike hit port infrastructure in Odesa region; Ukrainska Pravda reported significant damage to a DTEK energy facility in Odesa Oblast.

title: Sloviansk thermal power plant struck
summary: Zelenskyy said the Sloviansk thermal plant was hit as Russia again attacked DTEK thermal power plants in several oblasts overnight.

title: IRGC claims more tankers hit mines in Hormuz
summary: The IRGC Navy said a supertanker carrying over two million barrels struck a mine at the mouth of the strait, with counts of tankers hit varying from three to four across outlets. The claims, which Iran says involved ships on 'unauthorized' routes, were not independently verified.

title: Ukrainian drones set Novokuybyshevsk refinery ablaze
summary: Drones struck the Rosneft refinery in Samara Oblast, the first reported Ukrainian refinery strike in about two weeks; local authorities said two people died responding to fires. Russia said it intercepted more than 1,000 drones overnight.

title: Second mass drone wave shuts Moscow airports
summary: Mayor Sobyanin said 862 drones heading for Moscow were shot down; all four main airports suspended operations overnight. Russian figures were not independently verified.

title: Overnight Israeli strikes in central and southern Gaza
summary: The IDF said it destroyed two Hamas weapons depots overnight, including a strike on a building in Bureij camp; Palestinian medics reported drone strikes in Khan Younis killed two.

title: Drone intercepted near Mecca
summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a Houthi drone near Mecca; the Houthis denied targeting the city.

title: Houthi missiles target Aden palace and airport
summary: Yemen's government said the Houthis fired ballistic missiles at the Maashiq presidential palace and Aden airport; a security official said missiles struck near the palace. Casualties and damage were not disclosed.

title: Coalition airstrikes in al-Jawf, Marib and Taiz
summary: Houthi-affiliated media reported Saudi-led coalition air strikes across al-Jawf, Marib and Taiz governorates; Houthi health officials said a strike on a market in northern Yemen killed 14. Not independently verified.

title: Oman rescues 25 from burning tanker
summary: Oman said it rescued 25 sailors from a merchant ship set ablaze in an attack; UKMTO said the crew of the vessel was reported safe. Iran separately said it halted tankers in the strait.

title: Overnight drone strike on Kharkiv injures five
summary: Ukrainian officials said Russian forces attacked Kharkiv overnight, injuring five people.

title: Saudi air defenses intercept drone near Riyadh
summary: Coalition spokesman Turki al-Malki said a hostile drone was destroyed in the Riyadh region; debris fell without injuries. He did not say who launched it.

title: Neptune missiles and drones hit Kamensky rocket fuel plant
summary: Ukraine's General Staff said a strike on the solid-propellant plant in Kamensk-Shakhtinsky, Rostov Oblast, set a warehouse on fire and damaged four workshops; the Rostov governor confirmed an overnight attack.

title: Drone strike sets Ufa refinery on fire
summary: Drones attacked Ufa overnight, causing a fire at the Bashneft-Novoil refinery; an OSINT analyst suggested a catalytic reforming unit was hit. Not independently confirmed.

title: Drones hit Lukoil refinery in Kstovo
summary: Drones struck the NORSI refinery and the adjacent Novogorkovskaya heat and power plant in Nizhny Novgorod Oblast overnight; Russia opened a terrorism case and its Defence Ministry said 235 Ukrainian drones were downed.

title: Russian strikes cut power in four regions
summary: Zelensky said overnight strikes on substations and power lines in Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr and Khmelnytskyi regions left hundreds of thousands of households without power. Point shows Vinnytsia.

title: Israeli strikes kill eight in al-Mawasi and Gaza City
summary: Medics said two Israeli airstrikes, in al-Mawasi near Khan Younis and al-Rimal in Gaza City, killed eight Palestinians including five police officers. The Israeli military had no immediate comment.

title: Coalition downs Houthi drone aimed at southern Saudi Arabia
summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi drone launched toward southern Saudi Arabia. Point shows the southern border region generally.

title: Tanker struck by two projectiles off Saudi coast
summary: UKMTO said a tanker was hit by two projectiles about 72 nautical miles east of Ras Al Khafji late on Sunday; all crew were accounted for.

title: Offshore tug Selat Storm hit and partially sunk in Hormuz
summary: Maritime security firm Vanguard Tech said the Panama-flagged tug was struck by an unidentified projectile inside the strait and partially sank.

title: Tanker set on fire south of Lavan Island
summary: UKMTO said a vessel was hit on its port side by an unknown projectile about 40 nautical miles south of Iran's Lavan Island, causing a fire; the crew was reported safe.

title: IRGC says two more tankers exploded on mines
summary: The IRGC Navy claimed two tankers, including a supertanker, exploded after hitting mines on an 'unauthorised' route; it was unclear whether these were the ships UKMTO reported, and the claims were not independently verified.

title: Coalition 'precision operation' hits Hodeidah
summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it struck resources the Houthis use against Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping; Houthi-linked media reported two strikes on the University of Hodeida. The UN says over 300,000 have fled western Yemen.

title: RSF drones knock out Al Dabbah and Abu Hamad power stations
summary: Drone strikes took two power stations in northern Sudan out of service; Sudan Tribune counts 14 stations hit in two weeks. Lawyers' group Emergency Lawyers and the government blamed the RSF.

title: Army drone strike kills two in Al-Malha
summary: Darfur24 reported an army drone hit a commercial vehicle in RSF-held Al-Malha, North Darfur, killing two.

title: Overnight drone attack kills one in Sloviansk
summary: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched 193 drones overnight and 154 were downed; Donetsk's governor said one person was killed in Sloviansk, and energy strikes caused outages in 10 regions.

title: Drone attack injures 12 in Vashyshcheve
summary: Ukrainian officials said a Russian drone attack on the Kharkiv Oblast village injured 12 people, including a child.

title: Drones hit Transneft oil hub in Samara region
summary: Independent Russian media reported drones struck a Transneft pumping and blending station near Prosvet that blends Urals export crude; local authorities confirmed an attack without giving details, and Ukraine had not claimed it. Kyiv Post reported the fire was still burning a day later.

title: Israeli air raids on Kfar Tibnit and Qsair
summary: L'Orient Today reported intense Israeli air raids and artillery fire on southern Lebanon overnight into Monday, including Kfar Tibnit and Qsair near Nabatieh.

title: Israeli strikes and gunfire kill five in Gaza
summary: Gaza's civil defence agency said Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed five people across the Strip, including one in a strike on a vehicle in Gaza City; the Israeli military said it targeted militants.

title: US strikes Qeshm Island after IRGC fires at US aircraft
summary: US officials described limited 'defensive' strikes on Qeshm Island after the Revolutionary Guard fired at an American aircraft, aimed at the launcher, and said they were not a resumption of major combat. Iranian state media reported explosions; Central Command did not comment.

title: Guided bombs hit aid centre in Komyshuvakha, killing 55
summary: At least nine Russian guided bombs hit a school used for aid distribution and its shelter; Zelensky put the toll at 33 on Nov. 3 and bne IntelliNews reported it had risen to 40 by Nov. 5, and AP reported at least 55 by Nov. 9; the region declared three days of mourning. Russia's Defence Ministry said it targeted Ukrainian military units.

title: Houthi ballistic missile intercepted over southern Saudi Arabia
summary: The coalition said it destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile fired toward the south; civil defence issued alerts for Khamis Mushait, Abha, Taif and Najran before sounding the all-clear.

title: Massive overnight barrage targets Ukraine's power grid
summary: Zelensky said Russia launched 289 drones, 17 ballistic and 59 cruise missiles overnight, mainly at power plants and substations in several regions, causing emergency outages. Point shows central Ukraine generally.

title: Strike on Kharkiv hospital injures 73
summary: Prosecutors said a Russian strike on a hospital in Kharkiv's Nemyshlianskyi district injured 73 patients, staff and residents, and 226 patients were evacuated. Reports differ on whether a ballistic missile or a guided bomb was used.

title: Drones set Yaroslavl refinery ablaze
summary: The governor confirmed Ukrainian drones hit the Slavneft-YANOS refinery, Russia's fifth-largest, injuring two workers; footage showed at least seven fires. Russia's Defence Ministry said 856 drones were downed overnight.

title: Attacks on Crimea grid cause power cuts
summary: Russian-installed authorities said power cuts were imposed in at least five Crimean cities after attacks on the regional grid.

title: Tanker's engine room hit off Limah, Oman
summary: UKMTO said a tanker's engine room was struck by two unknown projectiles about 14 nautical miles northeast of Limah, one of two attacks it reported in the strait that day; no casualties were reported.

title: Israeli strikes kill four in Gaza, including a teenager
summary: AFP reported Israeli strikes near Khan Younis and Gaza City killed at least four, including a 17-year-old girl; Israel's military said it struck militants in al-Mawasi.

title: Coalition downs three drones; Houthis claim Asir strikes
summary: The coalition said it intercepted three drones, one over the Mecca region. A Houthi spokesman claimed strikes on Abha airport and King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, then said the group had not attacked Saudi territory that day.

title: IRGC claims four tankers destroyed by mines, two detained
summary: The IRGC said four tankers were destroyed by mines in a prohibited lane south of the strait and two other vessels were detained; it could not be verified whether these were linked to UKMTO-reported incidents.

title: 310 drones overnight; shopping centre ablaze in Odesa
summary: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched 310 drones, 81 of them jet-powered, and 272 were downed; strikes hit 19 locations, setting a shopping centre in Odesa on fire and injuring two in Dnipro. Energy sites in the west, including Ternopil, were also hit.

title: Seafarer killed as tanker Velos Sapphire hit north of Qatar
summary: UKMTO said a tanker was struck by two unidentified projectiles about 50 nautical miles north of Madinat ash Shamal late on Nov. 4 (early Nov. 5 local time). Operator Velos Tankers said one crew member of the empty Marshall Islands-flagged Velos Sapphire was killed; the IMO counts 25 seafarer deaths in 129 regional incidents.

title: Drones hit Ozon logistics centre in Adygeysk
summary: Ukrainian drones struck an Ozon logistics centre in Russia's Republic of Adygea; Ozon said the facility would temporarily suspend operations.

title: Over 200 drones attack Ryazan region
summary: The governor said falling debris started fires at industrial sites in Ryazan and cut power to parts of the city; Ukrainian channels claimed the oil refinery was hit, which officials didn't confirm. Russia said it downed about 500 drones overnight.

title: Drones and Kh-35 missiles hit Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv regions
summary: Ukraine said Russia launched 128 drones and two Kh-35 missiles, with 105 drones downed; strikes injured three in Dnipro and Samar, set a logistics site in Kyiv region ablaze, and Kyiv Post reported a woman killed.

title: Tanker reports explosion off Khasab, Oman
summary: UKMTO said an outbound tanker reported a blast on its port side near the waterline about 16 nautical miles east of Khasab; it continued under its own power and all crew were safe.

title: Israeli strikes kill five in Gaza, including a boy
summary: Rescue services said Israeli strikes and gunfire killed five people across Gaza, including a woman and a 12-year-old boy.

title: Israeli strikes on Kfar Tebnit and al-Mansouri
summary: Al Jazeera and Lebanon's NNA reported Israeli strikes on Kfar Tebnit in Nabatieh district and al-Mansouri in Tyre district.

title: Coalition destroys Houthi missile aimed at Medina
summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a missile launched by the Houthis toward Medina; the Houthis had not claimed an attack.

title: Drones set fire at Afipsky refinery
summary: Drones set off a large fire at the Afipsky refinery in Krasnodar Krai; regional authorities blamed drone debris, and Militarnyi reported a primary processing unit was damaged. Russia said 142 drones were downed overnight.

title: Trump announces 'minor' strikes on Iranian air defences
summary: Trump said the US carried out 'minor strikes' on Iran's air defences; Iranian media reported missiles hitting Qeshm Island, though Trump did not explicitly link the two. Iran called the US reply to its latest proposal 'not convincing'.

title: Israeli strikes on al-Tayri, Bint Jbeil district
summary: Middle East Eye, citing Lebanese reports, said Israeli forces bombed the al-Tayri municipality in southern Lebanon's Bint Jbeil district.

title: Drone strikes across Sudan; fuel station hit in South Kordofan
summary: Darfur24 reported army and RSF drone strikes in Blue Nile, the Kordofan states and North Darfur during the week; the toll from an RSF strike on a fuel station in Taqali al-Abbasiya rose to more than 19 civilians, and an RSF drone killed at least two in Damazin.

title: Missiles hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge and energy sites
summary: Officials said Russia launched 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles; several missiles hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge over the Dnipro, closing it, and one person was killed and eight wounded in the Kyiv area, plus one killed in Dnipropetrovsk region. Russia said it targeted the bridge, a plant it says makes Flamingo cruise missiles, and power and munitions sites.

title: Drones strike Saratov refinery
summary: Several fires broke out at the Saratov refinery after a drone attack overnight; no official damage assessment had been published.

title: Israeli shelling and demolition in Bani Haiyyan
summary: The Israeli army carried out artillery shelling and a demolition in the southern Lebanese village of Bani Haiyyan; no casualties were reported.

title: Houthi media: Saudi strike in Sanaa province kills 22
summary: Houthi-affiliated media said the death toll from a Saudi strike in Sanaa province rose to 22; the figure has not been independently verified.

title: US forces disable bulker Huda trying to run the blockade
summary: Central Command said it disabled the St Kitts and Nevis-flagged bulk carrier Huda in the Gulf of Oman after it made multiple attempts to pass the blockade of Iranian ports.

title: Crew abandon burning tanker off Khasab
summary: UKMTO said military authorities reported a tanker on fire about 8 nautical miles northwest of Khasab and that its crew had abandoned ship; a separate outbound tanker was hit by an unknown projectile about an hour later, with all crew safe. Open-source analysts tentatively identified the burning ship as the Navig8 Messi; that is unconfirmed.

title: Neptune missile hits factory in Oryol
summary: Ukraine's General Staff said it struck targets in Oryol, Saratov and Rostov regions overnight, including a factory in Oryol hit with a Neptune missile.

title: IRGC says three more tankers caught fire in Hormuz
summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said three oil tankers caught fire in the strait after hitting mines; UKMTO has not confirmed the mine strikes.

title: Russia says it hit three cargo ships near Odesa
summary: Russia's defence ministry said it struck three cargo ships near Odesa and Chornomorsk; Ukraine had not commented.

title: Strikes leave 600,000 without power in Dnipropetrovsk
summary: DTEK said an overnight Russian attack on energy facilities left more than 600,000 people in Dnipropetrovsk region without power; Russia said it hit substations there and in Zhytomyr region.

title: Missiles over Riyadh; debris damages Aramco building
summary: Saudi air defences said they intercepted three ballistic missiles, two cruise missiles and a drone, most aimed at Riyadh; falling debris damaged an Aramco building in the financial district, and the Energy Ministry said no one was hurt. The Houthis had claimed six attacks the previous day and say Saudi airstrikes have killed dozens of civilians; neither side's claims are verified.

title: Drone hits emergency crews at Komyshuvakha strike site
summary: AP reported a Russian drone hit emergency workers responding at the site of the Nov. 2 guided-bomb strike in Komyshuvakha; Ukraine has accused Russia of repeat strikes aimed at first responders.

title: Ukrainian drones set Kirishi refinery ablaze
summary: Leningrad region governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said a Ukrainian drone attack set fire to the Kirishi refinery, Russia's second-largest, before the fire was contained; he said one woman was killed by debris and 113 drones were downed. Euronews reported three main processing units were damaged, which has not been independently confirmed; Russia's defence ministry said it intercepted 430 Ukrainian drones across Russia and Crimea overnight.

title: 317 drones overnight; three killed in Odesa
summary: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched 317 long-range drones, 105 of them jet-powered, plus cruise missiles; Odesa's military administration said three people were killed in the city, and regional authorities reported 28 injured nationwide over the past day.

title: Houthi ministry: Saudi strikes east of Sanaa kill 44
summary: The Houthi-run health ministry said Saudi strikes in the Alshariyah area east of Sanaa killed 44 people, including more than 20 children; Saudi Arabia has not confirmed the strikes and the toll is unverified.

title: Israeli strikes kill three in Gaza, including a child
summary: Palestinian reports cited by Haaretz said three people, including a child, were killed and 16 wounded over 24 hours; Drop Site reported an airstrike on a shelter in Zeitoun, Gaza City, killed two. Counts differ between sources.

title: Israeli jets strike Qantara in south Lebanon
summary: Drop Site, citing Al Jazeera and Lebanon's NNA, reported Israeli jets attacked Qantara and forces fired toward the outskirts of Chaqra; no casualty figures were reported.

title: Overnight strikes hit gas station and oil facility in Sanaa
summary: Residents and the Houthis said overnight strikes in Sanaa hit a gas station and an oil facility, killing at least one person and wounding nine.
